Australia and US announce new visa rule changes

Australia announced a set of migration measures that modify student, visitor, skilled migration and working holiday visas, with the changes to be implemented progressively over the next 12 months. In the United States, the H‑1B visa program is slated for rule changes in 2026, outlined in nine points for visa workers, and new measures announced under President Trump have raised fresh questions for employers and workers.
